name: RF Signal Enhancer

verification.note: No manual is cited for the RF Signal Enhancer 2442. A signal repeater with no load to control is read as having no operating flags, settings or commands, which no document confirms.

sources: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008)

verification.note: Radio: the Tabletop Controller 2430 Owner's Manual says this product retransmits Insteon signals across both radio frequency and the powerline. The Insteon Developer's Guide (2009) says it is the only product using first-generation i1/RF, at 904 MHz, which can't communicate with the i2/RF radios of other products.
